facts.text: Bamboo Terry Waterproof Mattress Protector, (72 x 60 inches, Queen Size, White).
Top Layer/Outer Material: Bamboo feel terry; Back Side: Waterproof TPU (Thermoplastic Polyurethane).
TPU film with terry fabric allows air to pass through but blocks any fluids or liquids from seeping through to the mattress.
Our mattress protector also features elasticised corners, ensuring a snug fit around your mattress, no matter how much you toss and turn in your sleep.
The mattress protector is machine washable.
It is recommended to wash on a gentle machine cycle and tumble dry on low heat with linens and towels, or you can air-dry.
The soft, breathable and sweat-absorbent mattress protector with no crinkly noise ensures comfort and reduces irritation to leave you feeling refreshed every morning.
